research_scope.purpose: Discover useful everyday shared vocabulary; retain blocked senses and incomplete game ideas without promotion.

baseline_evidence.method: Parsed structured JSON; normalized candidate labels and 34 qualified/inflected forms against every KG label/alias, and candidate labels against all current world concept labels. Searched current tombstones and the listed archived rejection files as normalized strings; manually assessed Sticlă's related artwork hit. No blanket historical novelty or per-game exposure claim.
limitations: Twelve absent shared senses are research candidates, not twelve shipped words or rounds.
No native topology, accepted-form transaction, complete board, save migration, factual gate, independent quality gate or human playtest was performed.
Pre-2010 dictionaries count as one lexical/history signal family; different definitions on dexonline are not treated as independent public-recognition signals.
Commercial sources and paid media are marked and are not substitutes for independent recognition.
No new world concept is proposed because free concept slots alone do not establish reachable design.
shared_adoption_constraints: Any adoption needs a separate reviewed shared-graph transaction and the intended game's own raw factual/quality and final bound review rail. This pool is not importer input.
Recheck baseline identities and topology before selection. No edge, reverse traversal, incoming neighbor count, game eligibility, alias, recipe or round is installed here.

Runtime invariants: 7200-second sliding TTL, 1000 sessions/game, 64 KiB requests. Alchimie remains 251/256 concepts, 351/512 recipes, 96 occupied supplies, 12 occupied tiers, 256 saved crafts, 16 historical books and 2 MiB pre-write guard; world adoption would need a separate reachability and compatibility design.
Preserve n_v4gas_masa as meal and n_v86_kitchen_mixer as mixing/beating appliance, never furniture or blender.
